name: Chriscia Llamas
bio: Chriscia leads the guild: she sets the direction for the year, chairs the Executive Committee, and answers for everything UPCSG puts its name on.

name: Diane Bustamante
quote: Start where you are, with what you have.
bio: Diane works alongside the Executive Director to keep the committees moving, and steps in wherever a project needs a second pair of hands.

name: Irish Francisco
quote: If it wasn't written down, it didn't happen.
bio: Irish keeps the guild's records: minutes of every meeting, the membership roll, and the correspondence that goes out under the org's name.

name: Niño Pelenio
quote: Every peso has a paper trail.
bio: Nino handles the guild's funds - budgets for each event, collections for merch and dues, and the financial report the org answers to.

name: Tiffany Lalata
bio: Tiffany reviews the books independently of the Treasurer, checking that disbursements match what was approved and that the records hold up.

name: Emman Esperanza
quote: Good work deserves to be seen.
bio: Emman runs the guild's promotion: campaigns for events and merch drops, and making sure the things guilders build actually reach an audience.

name: Jasmine Monteroso
quote: Make it clear first. Then make it beautiful.
bio: Jasmine owns the guild's visual identity - publication materials, event branding, and the look of everything UPCSG publishes.

name: Sylvia Staheli
bio: Sylvia builds the guild's relationships outside the org: sponsors, partner organizations, and the industry contacts behind our talks and events.

name: June Abadia
quote: Teach the thing you struggled with.
bio: June runs the academic side of the guild - tutorials, workshops, and the study sessions that run every week rather than only before finals.

name: Erik Caliskis
quote: The venue, the schedule, and the group chat.
bio: Erik keeps events standing up: booking, equipment, timelines, and the internal communication that gets everyone to the right place.

name: Suzzane Tan
quote: Bring it up. That's what I'm here for.
bio: Suzzane represents UPCSG in the SRP, carrying guilder concerns into wider student representation and bringing decisions back to the org.
